Upside Down Text Generator

Flip your text upside down with real Unicode mappings — ˙ʇxǝʇ ǝdʎʇ noʎ — for fun bios and comments.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your text.
  2. It flips instantly using Unicode upside-down character mappings (and reverses the order).
  3. Copy and paste it anywhere for a playful effect.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does upside-down text work?

Each character is replaced by a Unicode lookalike that resembles it rotated 180° (e.g. "a" → "ɐ"), then the whole string is reversed so it reads correctly when flipped.

Do all characters flip?

Letters, digits and common punctuation have mappings. Characters without a good upside-down twin are kept as-is.

Will screen readers read it?

Poorly — screen readers speak the Unicode names of the flipped characters. Use it for decoration, not for important information.
